strings.name: Javier Bardem
strings.summary: From an acting family, Bardem studied painting before building his Spanish film career. Before Night Falls and The Sea Inside displayed his character work; No Country for Old Men earned him a supporting-actor Oscar. He moves between Spanish auteur films and English productions, from Biutiful to Skyfall and Dune, sustaining a cross-language acting career.
